get.description: Retrieve a list of URL redirects in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter redirects based on their creation or update timestamps, and sort the results. It supports pagination and can include archived redirects if specified.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Filter redirects created after the specified date-time.

parameters.name: createdAt
parameters.description: Filter redirects by their exact creation timestamp. The value should be in date-time format.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Filter redirects created before the specified date-time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Specify the fields to sort the results by. This is an array of strings.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Filter redirects updated after the specified date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAt
parameters.description: Filter redirects by their exact update timestamp. The value should be in date-time format.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Filter redirects updated before the specified date-time.

after.description: The cursor value indicating where to begin fetching the next page of results in a paginated collection.

link.description: An optional URL for directly accessing the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of UrlMapping objects, each representing a specific URL mapping.

created.description: The date and time when the URL mapping was initially created.

destination.description: The destination URL, where the target URL should be redirected if it matches the `routePrefix`.

id.description: The unique ID of this URL redirect.

isMatchFullUrl.description: Whether the `routePrefix` should match on the entire URL, including the domain.

isMatchQueryString.description: Whether the `routePrefix` should match on the entire URL path, including the query string.

isOnlyAfterNotFound.description: Whether the URL redirect mapping should apply only if a live page on the URL isn't found. If False, the URL redirect mapping will take precedence over any existing page.

isPattern.description: Whether the `routePrefix` should match based on pattern.

isProtocolAgnostic.description: Whether the `routePrefix` should match both HTTP and HTTPS protocols.

isTrailingSlashOptional.description: Whether a trailing slash will be ignored.

precedence.description: Used to prioritize URL redirection. If a given URL matches more than one redirect, the one with the **lower** precedence will be used.

redirectStyle.description: The type of redirect to create. Options include: 301 (permanent), 302 (temporary), or 305 (proxy). Find more details [here](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/cos-general/how-to-redirect-a-hubspot-page).

routePrefix.description: The target incoming URL, path, or pattern to match for redirection.

updated.description: The date and time when the URL mapping was last modified.

total.description: The total number of URL mappings available.
